# Social Stats

> Social Stats is an open-source, self-hostable social media management &
> marketing platform (MIT license) — an alternative to Hootsuite, Buffer and
> Sprout Social. Built with Django + React, it unifies a post scheduler,
> content calendar, cross-platform analytics (Facebook, Instagram, YouTube,
> LinkedIn, Google Business Profile), a unified inbox, a click-to-WhatsApp
> bot builder, CRM/leads, agency workspaces, and an AI assistant powered by
> the Anthropic API.

Key facts:
- Repository: https://github.com/cbsshekhawat18-lab/social-stats-social-media-manager
- License: MIT — free to self-host, no feature gating
- Quick start: `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` (prebuilt
  multi-arch images on GHCR), or manual setup with Python 3.11–3.12 + Node 18
- Demo data: `docker compose exec backend python manage.py demo_setup`
- Stack: Django 4.2, Django REST Framework, Channels (WebSockets), Celery +
  Redis, PostgreSQL/SQLite, React 18, React Query, Zustand
